title: 第13章 异族第14章 并非唯一
content_zh:
没头没脑又费了半晚上逃回十字镇的艾什和巴尼，两人疲劳的坐在十字镇北门外的树下，一同眼神发直的望着那一抹初阳升于空中，折腾了一晚上，两人都不愿意再动弹一下，只是发着呆。
早起的镇民们已经开始了一天的生活，镇子内逐渐变得人声鼎沸，而艾什发现，没有一个镇民前往镇子北门，许多镇民甚至连在北门附近都不愿意多停留，匆匆忙忙的离开了。
这一反常现象使得艾什不由得琢磨起来，看那些镇民似乎很忌惮镇子北门的样子，他们在害怕什么？还是在担忧什么？跑了一夜的艾什拍着身上的泥土站起来，揉着发痛的脑袋对身边的巴尼说：
“巴尼，情况不对啊，这十字镇，好像能进不能出啊？”
巴尼已经没什么力气和艾什交谈了，他又累又困的坐在地上，眼神呆滞，他尽力抬眼看了看还有精力的艾什，闭上眼换了个舒服的姿势后仰靠在城墙上，打了个哈欠说：
“我已经累的不想再去思考了，艾什，我不行了，我要......先歇一歇......”
“我觉得我们没有时间休息了，巴尼，辛苦你多买一些食物，然后在北门等我，顺便休息一会儿吧，我去镇子里逛一逛。”
艾什掏着口袋，给了巴尼两枚银币，转身拉低兜帽，向十字镇内部走去，她正琢磨着为什么随心之子游击队要费时费力的修建城墙时，一支由镇民、随心之子游击队组成的队伍，向艾什迎面而来。
艾什快步走到街边让开道路，眼睛盯着队伍看，队伍里的镇民们手里扛着斧头、绳子和钉子，随心之子游击队员们除了带上了武器外，也都拿着斧头之类的工具。
稍微侧耳倾听队伍中镇民和随心之子游击队员的交谈，听到这支队伍是要去和森林里某伐木，建设城墙的队伍轮换的，在森林里建造围墙的队伍好像有了损失。
除此之外，艾什就只能听到一些说帝国语的镇民们，和说非帝国语的镇民咒骂，他们骂着什么异族，什么本来很和平的之类的话，艾什还偶然听到两个镇民小声的凑一起暗骂随心之子游击队员们，说如果不是他们，十字镇很安稳的。
等队伍完全离去，艾什拢拢斗篷，不禁好奇起来，随心之子游击队占领了十字镇，他们要做什么？他们为什么要带镇民修建那堵连帝国的军队，都不会费时费力修建的城墙？为什么他们要控制镇民？昨晚墙外的吼叫声又是什么生物？
有太多的疑问了，艾什想了想，先试着从十字镇南门离开吧，如果能离开的话，她和巴尼绕个路离开十字镇就好，她可不想多在十字镇长久停留，自己身上的钱币可不支持自己呆那么久。
等艾什穿过镇子，来到之前进入十字镇的南门时，果然，随心之子的游击队员拦住了艾什，要求艾什出示离开镇子的公文，艾什故意磕磕绊绊的用帝国语回答自己没有，伪装成自己不会帝国语的样子。
随心之子游击队员们蛮横的推搡艾什的肩膀，让她滚回去，想要出镇，必须获得随心之子领导者，威尔.格兰特亲手签名的离镇文书，否则就滚回镇子里该干嘛干嘛。
艾什弯腰对随心之子游击队员鞠躬，语气礼貌又谦逊的表示打扰了，转身艾什就加快了步伐，果然，随心之子游击队不会放任何人离开，而且像艾什这样被强迫留下的人不少。
等她走到广场附近时，她看到广场西侧的议会厅处，议会厅大门口聚集起了一群人，这些人周围汇聚起来牲畜和马车，大包小裹的物品都堆积在马车上，人们吵吵嚷嚷的要求见到威尔.格兰特，签署离镇文书。
然而议会厅门口站岗的随心之子游击队员手持长矛，拦住了进入议会厅大门的路，对那些可能是商人的人们喊声充耳不闻，有人试着进入议会厅或和游击队员们交谈，必然会被游击队员一顿辱骂，被驱离开。
艾什皱起眉头，她看了一会儿吵闹的人群，目光锁定在人群边缘马车上坐着叹气的车夫，艾什悄悄走过去，对着马车夫右手扶胸弯腰稍微鞠了一躬，语气和善的问道：
“您好，请问可以向您打听一些事情吗？”

马车夫听到有人叫他，转头上下看了看被兜帽遮住大半身子和脸的艾什，他从腰上拽下长杆烟斗，边往里面塞着劣质烟叶边点点头，不耐烦她的哼了声，极其不爽的说：
“什么事？小姐，请您快一点，我还要排队等待申请离镇公文。”
“请问您来十字镇很久了吗？为什么随心之子们不允许我们离开？”
艾什和善的问着，顺手把手摸进兜里，向马车夫伸手递出5枚铜币，马车夫很自然的垂手接过艾什的“咨询费”
，他小心的看了眼在人群里还在大喊大叫的雇主，从马车上跳下来点燃长杆烟斗抽了两口后叹气道：
“唉......小姐，您也不是本地人吧？我和米多斯老爷被困在十字镇快两周了，我们本来是沿着瓦斯特森林主路向沿途边民镇贩卖香料的，结果到了这，随心之子就把我们扣下不让离开了，好像是因为他们在查帝国间谍，在招募人手去北边修围墙。”
本小章还未完，请点击下一页继续阅读后面精彩内容！
“那为什么要修建围墙呢？随心之子又为什么要占领十字镇呢？”
艾什继续问道。
马车夫一听，更是加重了叹气，摇头无奈说：
“听说随心之子在两个月前突然从北方涌入十字镇，镇民们最开始以为他们只是来镇子内补给而已，后来他们赖着不走了，连他们的首领威尔.格兰特都占据了镇议会厅，控制镇民不许大家离开，还赶走了在镇子里居住不知道多少代的异族们。”
“我们被扣留的这段时间里，米多斯老爷打听到，随心之子在修建那堵木墙不止一天两天了，他们在占领这里前就在修建，现在他们需要更多的人来造墙，他们抓走了无业游民和乞丐们，都去修墙了，好像.....是为了和北方的异族们隔绝开吧？”
“异族？我朋友说，瓦斯特森林内异族不是不会轻易攻击城镇吗？怎么还要赶走异族，又要防御异族？”
艾什更加迷惑了，她抱着胳膊压低了嗓音问着，马车夫噘嘴翻白眼，一副不屑的样子说：
“随心之子中有大嘴巴说瓦斯特森林中的兽人部落要入侵帝国，他们入侵路线上的所有城镇都将被摧毁，随心之子不想放弃十字镇这一主要物资补给镇，所以来保护十字镇，说实话，小姐，我跟着米多斯老爷与兽人也贸易过许多年，他们不会入侵的。”
“不会入侵？我想也是，如今瑞文盖德帝国士兵多到数不清，还有火枪火炮这样独特的武器，兽人们不会主动找麻烦的，先生您还真是见识多。”
艾什假意附和着马车夫的“博学多才”
，试着从他嘴里获得更多的事，而马车夫被艾什夸了一句后，发黄的皮肤迅速转红，他抽了口烟，很礼貌的扭开脸没有喷向艾什，笑呵呵的说：
“兽人们是野蛮些，但是他们也是可以好好交流的，兽人怎么会入侵帝国呢？米多斯老爷说，就是随心之子的首领，威尔.格兰杰想要十字镇罢了，你看看北方修建的城墙，都快把十字镇包围了！”
“那有没有空隙可以.....让想去北方游历的冒险者，有条路可以离开呢？”
content_en:
Ash and Barney, who had no idea and spent half the night escaping back to Cross Town, sat tiredly under the tree outside the north gate of Cross Town, staring straight at the sun rising in the sky. After struggling all night, neither of them was willing to move again, just in a daze.
The townspeople who got up early had already started their day's life, and the town gradually became bustling with people. However, Ash found that none of the townspeople went to the north gate of the town. Many townspeople were not even willing to stay near the north gate and left in a hurry.
This abnormal phenomenon made Ash couldn't help but wonder. Seeing that the townspeople seemed to be afraid of the north gate of the town, what were they afraid of? What are you still worried about? Ash, who had been running all night, patted the dirt on his body and stood up, rubbing his aching head and said to Barney beside him:
"Barney, something is wrong. Is it possible to enter or exit Cross Town?"
Barney no longer had the energy to talk to Ash. He sat on the ground tired and sleepy, his eyes dull. He tried his best to raise his eyes to look at Ash, who still had energy. He closed his eyes, changed into a comfortable position, leaned back against the wall, yawned and said:
"I'm so tired that I don't want to think anymore. Ash, I can't do it anymore. I need to... take a rest first..."
"I think we don't have time to rest. Barney, please buy some more food and wait for me at the north gate. Take a rest while I go to the town for a walk."
Ash dug into his pocket, gave Barney two silver coins, turned around, lowered his hood, and walked towards the interior of Cross Town. When she was wondering why the Sons of Sui Xin guerrillas had to waste time and effort building the city wall, a team composed of townspeople and Sons of Sui Xin guerrillas came towards Ash.
Ash quickly walked to the side of the street to get out of the way, staring at the team. The townspeople in the team were carrying axes, ropes, and nails. In addition to weapons, the Sons of the Heart guerrillas also held tools such as axes.
I listened carefully to the conversation between the townspeople and the Sons of Sui Xin guerrillas in the team, and heard that this team was going to rotate with a team that was logging and building a city wall in the forest. The team that was building the wall in the forest seemed to have suffered a loss.
In addition, Ash could only hear some townspeople who spoke Imperial language and townspeople who spoke non-Imperial language cursing about aliens and things that were originally peaceful. Ash also accidentally heard two townspeople whispering together to curse the Sons of Suit guerrillas, saying that if it weren't for them, Crosstown would be very stable.
After the team had completely left, Ash gathered his cloak and couldn't help but become curious. The Sons of the Heart guerrillas had occupied Cross Town. What were they going to do? Why did they lead the townspeople to build a city wall that even the imperial army would not waste time and effort to build? Why do they want to control the townspeople? What creature was that roaring outside the wall last night?
There were too many questions. Ash thought about it and tried to leave through the south gate of Cross Town first. If she could leave, she and Barney could just take a detour and leave Cross Town. She didn't want to stay in Cross Town for a long time, and the money she had on her didn't support her staying that long.
When Ash passed through the town and came to the south gate that he had entered Cross Town before, sure enough, the guerrillas of the Sons of Sui Xin stopped Ash and asked Ash to show him the official document to leave the town. Ash deliberately stumbled and answered in Imperial dialect that he had not, pretending that he did not know Imperial dialect.
The Sons of Desire guerrillas pushed Ash's shoulders arrogantly, telling her to go back. If she wanted to leave the town, she had to obtain a leaving document signed by the leader of the Sons of Desire, Will Grant. Otherwise, she would have to go back to the town and do whatever she wanted.
Ash bent down and bowed to the Sons of Sui Xin guerrillas, expressing politely and humbly that he was sorry for bothering him. He turned around and stepped up his pace. Sure enough, the Sons of Sui Xin guerrillas would not let anyone leave, and they were forced to stay like Ash.There are many people.
When she walked near the square, she saw a group of people gathered at the parliament hall on the west side of the square. Livestock and carriages gathered around these people, and large and small packages of items were piled on the carriage. People clamored to see Will Grant and sign the documents to leave town.
However, the Sons of Sui Xin guerrillas standing guard at the door of the parliament hall were holding spears and blocked the way into the door of the parliament hall. They turned a deaf ear to the shouts of those who might be businessmen. Anyone who tried to enter the parliament hall or talk to the guerrillas would inevitably be insulted by the guerrillas and driven away.
Ash frowned. She looked at the noisy crowd for a while, and her eyes locked on the sighing coachman sitting on the carriage at the edge of the crowd. Ash quietly walked over, bowed slightly to the coachman with his right hand on his chest, and asked in a kind tone:
"Hello, may I ask you something?"
When the coachman heard someone calling him, he turned his head and looked up and down at Ash, whose body and face were covered by a hood. He pulled the long pipe from his waist and stuffed low-quality tobacco leaves into it while nodding. He snorted impatiently and said with great displeasure:
"What's the matter? Miss, please hurry up, I have to wait in line to apply for the official document of leaving town."
"Excuse me, have you been in Cross Town for a long time? Why don't the Sons of the Heart allow us to leave?"
Ash asked kindly, put his hand into his pocket, and handed out 5 copper coins to the coachman. The coachman naturally took Ash's "consultation fee" with his lower hand.
, he looked carefully at his employer who was still shouting in the crowd, jumped down from the carriage, lit a long pipe, took two puffs, and sighed:
"Oh...Miss, you are not a local, are you? Master Meadows and I have been trapped in Cross Town for almost two weeks. We were originally selling spices along the main road of Wast Forest to the border towns along the way. But when we got here, Suixin detained us and refused to leave. It seems because they were investigating imperial spies and recruiting people to build the wall in the north."

"Then why build the wall? And why did the Sons of Heart take over Crosstown?"
Ash continued to ask.
When the coachman heard this, he sighed even more, shook his head and said helplessly:
"I heard that the Sons of Sui Xin suddenly poured into Cross Town from the north two months ago. The townspeople initially thought they were just coming to the town for supplies, but later they refused to leave. Even their leader Will Grant occupied the town council hall and controlled the townspeople not to leave. He also drove away the aliens who had lived in the town for countless generations."
"During the time we were detained, Mr. Meadows found out that the Sons of Sui Xin had been building the wooden wall for more than a day or two. They were building it before they occupied this place. Now they need more people to build the wall. They captured the homeless and beggars and built the wall. It seems... to isolate them from the foreigners in the north, right?"
"Aliens? My friend said, don't the aliens in Wast Forest not easily attack the town? Why do we have to drive away the aliens and defend them at the same time?"
Ash was even more confused. She crossed her arms and asked in a low voice. The coachman pursed his lips and rolled his eyes, saying with a look of disdain:
"There are loudmouths among the Sons of Sui Xin who say that the orc tribe in the Vast Forest will invade the empire, and all the towns on their invasion route will be destroyed. The Sons of Sui Xin do not want to give up Cross Town, a major supply town, so they come to protect Cross Town. To be honest, Miss, I have been trading with the orcs for many years with Master Midos, and they will not invade."
"Won't invade? I think so. Nowadays, the Ravengard Empire has countless soldiers and unique weapons such as muskets and artillery. The orcs will not take the initiative to cause trouble. Sir, you are really knowledgeable."
AiEven pretending to echo the coachman's "eruditeness"
, trying to get more things from his mouth. After the coachman was praised by Ash, his yellow skin quickly turned red. He took a puff of cigarette, turned his face away politely and did not spray it at Ash, and said with a smile:
"The orcs are more barbaric, but they can also communicate well. How could the orcs invade the empire? Master Meadows said that the leader of the Sons of Sui Xin, Will Granger, just wants Crosstown. Look at the city walls built in the north, they are almost surrounding Crosstown!"
"Is there any gap that allows adventurers who want to travel to the north to have a way to leave?"
